name: @w6w-apps/webinargeek
description: Manage WebinarGeek webinars, broadcasts, subscribers and payments.

w6w.longDescription:
WebinarGeek runs the webinar itself — a webinar's episodes, the individual broadcasts (live sessions or the always-on on-demand playback) they schedule, and the subscribers who register for one — and this app brings that lifecycle into a workflow over WebinarGeek's own REST API v2.

List and read webinars and their broadcasts, schedule a new broadcast for an existing episode, and subscribe or unsubscribe an end-user directly rather than routing them through the hosted registration page — one broadcast at a time, or a whole webinar series in one call. Once a broadcast has run, subscription, payment, chat-message and Q&A data can be read back to drive follow-up automation: a CRM sync for no-shows, a follow-up email for attendees who watched the replay, or an export of who paid for a ticketed webinar.

A common pattern is triggering a workflow off an external event — a course enrollment, a CRM stage change, a landing-page form — and subscribing the person to the right webinar directly, or reading subscriptions/payments back afterward to decide who gets which follow-up.

This app covers the everyday webinar/broadcast/subscription/payment/message/question lifecycle documented in WebinarGeek's v2 API; it does not cover webinar or episode creation/editing, team members, or any part of the deprecated v1 API, which are either undocumented for v2 or left for a follow-up pass.
